decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation extends the firm's established laser offer and fits its single-source direction, so a 2023 launch is kept despite its lower visibility, with only a modest chance of being quietly dropped because it is only mentioned on the website.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core portfolio, is visibly committed to on its own web page, and drives consumables revenue, so management will persist and treat any early weakness as a ramp-up issue.

The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer reflects in-house development investment and public commitment through its own web page, and it is central to the firm's push toward high-resolution coding and traceability, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
